g.text: An alert budget changes the operating cutoff
Synthetic walkthrough / learning references, choosing a candidate, and seeing the tradeoff

Evaluate the fixed choices on separate data

All observations are synthetic. A tighter alert budget reduces alerts and outcome coverage in this example.
